Flippa's referral programme pays referrers 20% (monthly, $5 minimum payout) per https://flippa.com/referral-program (accessed 2026-09-14). This is a commission relationship, not an endorsement.
what_it_is: Flippa is an online marketplace (founded June 2009, spun out of SitePoint by Mark Harbottle and Matt Mickiewicz; legal entity Flippa.com Pty Ltd, ACN 135 570 713) where owners list digital businesses — SaaS, ecommerce, content sites, apps, domains — for sale to a global buyer pool. The 'free valuation' page is a marketing entry point to an automated valuation calculator that estimates what a business might sell for on Flippa. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flippa; https://flippa.com/terms-of-service (accessed 2026-09-14).
how_it_works: VALUATION: free, instant, 'no login required' per https://flippa.com/free-valuation (accessed 2026-09-14). Owner inputs business model, category, age, revenue/profit data; Flippa compares inputs against its sales history ('1000's of similar sites', '100k+ comparable business sales across 100+ countries', 'less than 3 minutes' per https://flippa.com/sell). Output is an estimated value range with profit and revenue multiples. Flippa's own help centre: 'While it provides a reliable estimate, remember that it's a guide only' and recommends starting asking price at 2–2.5× annual net profit; for a detailed professional valuation it sells a paid Verification & Assessment report from $1,500 (https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000649315, updated 2026-08-09; https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000661815). LISTING: registration required; choose 3–30-day auction (with reserve price; buyers must be accepted by the seller to bid) or classified/fixed-price listing (open-ended, offers accepted at seller's discretion) — https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001027475 (updated 2026-05-21) and https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001027595. AUCTION: highest bid over reserve wins; auto-extension up to 1 hour for late bids; if reserve not met, listing transitions to open offers (https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001136036). CLOSE: payment via Escrow.com, FlippaPay, or PayPal; asset transfer is between buyer and seller — 'Flippa does not take part in any transfer' (article 360001027475).
fees: All in USD. Access date 2026-09-14 for https://flippa.com/pricing and https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000774276 (updated 2026-08-21). LISTING FEES (self-service): asking price < $10K: Entry $29 (60-day), Boosted $49 (3-month), Premium $199/6mo; $10K–$49.9K: Standard $49, Premium $399, Ultimate $599 per 6 months; $50K–$99.9K: $129/$399/$699 per 6 months. NDA add-on $199 on cheaper tiers. Broker-led sales: single upfront brokerage fee $399 ($100K–$249.9K), $499 ($250K–$499.9K), $899 ($500K–$999.9K), $1,299 ($1M–$9.9M), $1,499 ($10M+), 6-month term. SUCCESS FEES (mandatory, % of final sale price, by asking-price bucket): 10% up to $500K; 9% ($500K–$999.9K); 8% ($1M–$4.9M); 7% ($5M–$9.9M); 6% ($10M–$49.9M); 5% ($50M+). Help-centre FAQ wording: 'Entry Level Package starts at $29 and success fees start from 5%' (https://flippa.com/pricing FAQ). NOTE a discrepancy: the free-valuation page says 'Platform fees start from USD$39' while the pricing page entry package is $29. ESCROW/CLOSING: Escrow.com fees $0–$5K: 3.25% ($10 min); $5K–$25K: $162.50 + 0.26% over $5K; $25K+: 0.89%, with a 20% Flippa discount paid by buyer; ~$20 international wire fee may fall on the seller. FlippaPay from 0.5% of sale price on transactions ≥$10K, paid by buyer. BUYER SUBSCRIPTION: Flippa Premium $49/month (21-day early access to new listings >$10K, instant NDA approval); free tier still transacts. Buyer $5 card hold + $500 authorisation on bids/offers ≥$5,000. REFUNDS: withdrawing a listing generally forfeits the listing fee (https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000063356); unverified data leads to cancellation with full refund (article 4842857720079).
documented_limitations: Valuation is an automated estimate from seller-provided inputs and comparable sales — Flippa itself labels it 'a guide only' and sells a separate paid service for professional valuation: https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000649315

Accuracy depends on inputs: 'If the information you provide is accurate, your Flippa valuation will be a good indicator of price' — https://flippa.com/free-valuation; no broker opinion or audited financials underpin it

Calculator landing pages disclaim: 'Actual sale prices vary based on buyer competition, current market conditions, and negotiation' — https://landing.flippa.com/youtube-channel-worth-calculator (accessed 2026-09-14)

Flippa caps asking prices against its own data: max 8× verified annual revenue (businesses < $1M revenue), 2× Flippa valuation (≥ $1M, formal valuation required), 1× revenue for loss-making businesses, $9,999 for pre-revenue assets — https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/12856932906767 (updated 2026-09-02). A high free valuation does not mean you may list at that price.
Self-service requires ≥6 months trading history and profit; broker matching has separate eligibility criteria — https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000902435
Fees are payable even when the sale takes months; success fee applies to final sale price regardless of whether it matches the valuation
Flippa does not perform or guarantee the asset transfer itself (article 360001027475)

Public marketing claims (12,000+ deals annually, '~40,000 weekly active buyers', '$73 Billion Active Buyer Liquidity', 'over 450,000 business owners', '2x more likely to sell' with a broker) are self-reported on https://flippa.com/sell and https://flippa.com/pricing with no published methodology

Third-party review sentiment is mixed: Trustpilot shows ~4/5 from ~3,200+ reviews; Sitejabber ~2.6/5 (search snippets, 2026-09-14; Trustpilot itself blocked scraping so figures are from search-result descriptions only)
trust_signals: Operating since June 2009 (Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flippa), originally Australian (Melbourne), now offices in Austin, Nice, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Manila, Melbourne, London, Singapore (https://flippa.com/free-valuation footer). Legal entity Flippa.com Pty Ltd, ACN 135 570 713 (https://flippa.com/terms-of-service, last updated 2025-11-06). Raised a US$11M Series A led by OneVentures (announced 2021-09-20, Wikipedia; ~US$15M total funding per Tracxn). CEO Blake Hutchison; co-founder Mark Harbottle remains involved. OWNERSHIP NOTE: no evidence found on 2026-09-14 (Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo, Flippa newsroom searches) that Flippa is owned by 'Acx'; searches for 'Flippa acquired by ACX' returned nothing corroborating it — treat that claim as unverified. Deals range 'from $10,000 to $30,000,000'; largest recorded sale a US$35M Singapore app portfolio (Wikipedia). Verified-sales process: 'Data Verified' badge = read-only third-party data connections (Google Analytics, AdSense, AdMob, Shopify, Stripe, WooCommerce, QuickBooks) that neither seller nor Flippa can edit; 'Vetted by Flippa' badge = manual human verification of revenue, expenses and traffic for listings ≥$50,000, and listings that cannot supply data are cancelled and refunded — https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/4842857720079 (updated 2026-06-16). Sellers must verify claims when a buyer makes an offer; Flippa reserves the right to remove listings or cancel sales where data cannot be verified (free-valuation FAQ). Integrity/fraud team plus banned-behaviour and prohibited-content policies (https://support.flippa.com/hc/en-us/articles/5974444302351, updated 2026-09-14).
who_it_fits: Owner-operated digital businesses (SaaS, ecommerce, content, apps) with at least 6 months' clean, verifiable profit history that want to test real market demand quickly; sellers who can connect Stripe/GA/Shopify-type data so buyers can verify; owners of sub-$1M-revenue assets for whom a public auction or classified listing plus self-service tools is proportionate; anyone wanting a free, instant sanity-check of what recent comparables on a large marketplace imply. Also fits price-sensitive buyers doing their own due diligence, since browsing and transacting need no subscription.
who_it_does_not_fit: Pre-revenue or loss-making businesses (severe price caps: $9,999 or 1× revenue; value is mostly 'potential', which Flippa's rules restrict hard); businesses with <6 months' trading history for self-service; sellers unwilling to grant data access or remote-screening sessions for verification; owners needing a defensible formal valuation (e.g. for partners, lenders, or tax) — Flippa's tool is explicitly 'a guide only' and a broker opinion costs $1,500+; very large exits ($50M+ where traditional M&A advisers may serve better); anyone expecting the automated range to be a guaranteed sale price; prohibited categories (adult, weapons, Flippa-sourced income ≥30%, duplicate marketplaces, unverifiable claims).
open_questions_for_a_seller: What inputs did I give the calculator, and how would the number change if a buyer or broker recomputed my SDE (owner salary and add-backs) differently?
Will my asking price survive Flippa's caps (8× verified revenue / 2× valuation / 1× revenue if loss-making), and does my category qualify?
What is my all-in cost if the business does NOT sell — listing fee forfeited on withdrawal, renewal/auto-renew terms, 50%-off relist rules?
Which payment rails apply to my deal and who pays them: Escrow.com %s (buyer, 20% Flippa discount), ~$20 international wire fee (possible seller cost), FlippaPay from 0.5%?
Am I prepared to prove every claim (revenue, expenses, traffic) via read-only integrations or a remote session, knowing unverified listings are cancelled?
Do my contracts transfer — is ≥30% of my income sourced from Flippa or another platform's account (e.g. Etsy, Amazon, AdSense) whose ToS restrict transfer?
Self-service or broker? The pricing page claims '2x more likely to sell' with a broker — what is the evidence for my size band, and what does the broker fee add to the success percentage?
Can I list elsewhere simultaneously? (Allowed for classifieds but other live listings must close on acceptance; forbidden for auctions.)
Is '67% cross-border deals / buyers from 193 countries' relevant to my asset, and what tax/entity implications come with a foreign buyer?
What happens to the valuation range if buyer demand in my niche shifts between valuation day and listing day (Premium buyers see new listings 21 days early — am I disadvantaged as a seller?)
valuation_conventions: Flippa guidance: start at 2–2.5× annual net profit (help centre, article 360000649315). Flippa's own SaaS blog: smaller SaaS typically 2.5×–4.5× SDE, revenue multiples 2.0×–3.5×; mid-market 3.5×–6× EBITDA; SDE = net profit + owner salary + one-time/discretionary add-backs (https://flippa.com/blog/how-to-value-a-saas-company, 2026). Category calculators publish ranges, e.g. YouTube channels 12–36× monthly profit by niche (https://landing.flippa.com/youtube-channel-worth-calculator). Multiple is driven by growth, churn/retention, owner dependency, age, and buyer demand — Flippa blog + help articles above. These are Flippa-published conventions, not independent appraisals.
